ku.text: The slope between two points is $m=(y_2-y_1)/(x_2-x_1)$ when $x_2\ne x_1$.
A nonvertical line can be written $y=mx+c$ or $y-y_1=m(x-x_1)$.
Parallel lines have equal gradients; perpendicular nonvertical lines have gradients whose product is $-1$.

misc.weak: Using the same slope for a perpendicular line
misc.better: For nonzero $m$, the perpendicular slope is $-1/m$.
